title: Five transients appearing and vanishing on 27 July 1952

tellings.quote: One is five objects on a narrow band. And it's from the 27th of July 1952.

plain: An astronomer, Beatriz Villarroel, studies old photographic glass plates of the night sky taken at the Palomar Observatory, looking for points of light that appear and then vanish. She says one plate from July 27, 1952 shows five such objects lined up in a narrow band. If true, it could point to unexplained objects near Earth caught on film long ago.
